Aggregate arrival curve at each egress port is sum of affine arrivals of all flows using that egress port.

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_per_flow: For flow f with frame size l_f (bits) and period P_f (us): alpha_f(t) = l_f + (l_f/P_f) * t for t>0.
WCD_calculation.per_port_aggregate_arrival: For each egress port h, alpha_M^h(t) = sum over all flows using port h of [l_f + (l_f/P_f)*t].
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_M^h(t) = idleSlope * [t - c_max/idleSlope]^+ with idleSlope = 75 bits/us and c_max = 0 (no higher/lower-priority). Hence beta_M^h(t) = 75 * t.
WCD_calculation.per_hop_delay_bound: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_M^h, beta_M^h) = b_sum / (R - rho_sum) with R = 75 bits/us, b_sum = sum l_f, rho_sum = sum(l_f/P_f), provided rho_sum < R.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_over_hops D_f^h + hop_count * (prop_delay_per_hop + switch_delay_per_hop) with prop_delay_per_hop=1 us and switch_delay_per_hop=1 us.

Frame size used equals provided payload (no L2 overhead added)
CBS applied at switch egress ports only; end stations not shaping

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: For each flow f at its source: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f * t with b_f = l_f (Bytes), rho_f = l_f / P_f (Bytes/us), t>0.
WCD_calculation.service_curve_per_port: CBS Class A service (rate-latency): beta_A^h(t) = idleSlope * [t - c_max/idleSlope]^+ with idleSlope = 0.75*C; here c_max = 0 (no lower-priority), so beta_A^h(t) = idleSlope * t.
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay: D_h = hDev(alpha_A^h, beta_A^h) = B_total_h / (idleSlope - r_total_h) + T_credit, with B_total_h = sum l_f over flows through port h, r_total_h = sum (l_f / P_f), T_credit = c_max/idleSlope = 0.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_{ports h on f's route} D_h + hop_count_f * (prop_delay + switch_delay) + time_sync_error.

missing_inputs: Clarification on whether time synchronization error should be added per hop or once per flow (assumed once per flow).

Whether Ethernet L2 overhead (headers, IFG, preamble) should be added to payload to form l_f (assumed frame size equals given payload).
Whether end-station shaping exists (assumed CBS only at switch egress ports).
Potential burst growth (rho*D) propagation across hops not specified; Total Flow Analysis used with aggregate bursts at each port.

assumptions.note: Maximum lower-priority (best-effort) frame size assumed as VLAN-tagged Ethernet MTU for CBS credit upper bound; frame payloads used directly as frame sizes (no L2 overhead added) as not provided.

formulas_used.arrival_curve_source: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f * t, with b_f = l_f (bytes), rho_f = l_f / P_f (bytes/us), t>0
formulas_used.arrival_curve_propagation: At next server h: b_f(h) = b_f(h-) + rho_f * D_f(h-)

CBS_credit_bounds.c_max: c_max_i^h = idleSlope_i^h * (sum_{j<i} c_min_j^h - l_{>i}^{h,max}) / (sum_{j<i} idleSlope_j^h - C); for single class A with no higher classes -> c_max = idleSlope * l_BE^{max} / C

formulas_used.CBS_service_curve: beta_i^h(t) = idleSlope_i^h * [t - c_max_i^h / idleSlope_i^h]^+; define R = idleSlope, T = c_max/idleSlope
formulas_used.per_port_delay: D^h = T^h + b_total^h / (R - rho_total^h), valid if rho_total^h < R
formulas_used.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_h D^h (for ports h on path of f) + hop_count_f * (Propagation + Switching) + Time_sync_error

WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_equation: D^h = T^h + b_total^h / (R - rho_total^h), where R = IdleSlope (bytes/us), T^h = c_max^h / IdleSlope, b_total^h = sum_over_flows_g_on_port_h (b_g(h)), rho_total^h = sum_over_flows_g_on_port_h (rho_g)
WCD_calculation.burst_propagation: b_f(h_next) = b_f(h_prev) + rho_f * D_f(h_prev), initialized with b_f(source) = l_f and rho_f = l_f / P_f
WCD_calculation.CBS_credit_bounds_used: c_max^h = IdleSlope * l_BE_max / C, c_min^h = SendSlope * l_A^{h,max} / C
WCD_calculation.service_curve_form: beta^h(t) = IdleSlope * [t - T^h]^+ with T^h = c_max^h / IdleSlope
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = (sum of D^h over all egress ports h on the flow path) + hop_count_f * (1 us propagation + 1 us switching) + 1 us time synchronization error

missing_inputs: Maximum lower priority (best-effort) frame size per egress port (l_BE_max); assumed 1522 Bytes for all ports.
Exact Ethernet L2 overhead to convert payload to on-wire frame size (preamble, SFD, IFG, MAC/VLAN headers, FCS); payload was used directly as frame size.

F0.SendSlope: idleSlope - C = 75 Mbps - 100 Mbps = -25 Mbps = -3.125 B/us

F1.SendSlope: idleSlope - C = 75 Mbps - 100 Mbps = -25 Mbps = -3.125 B/us

F2.SendSlope: idleSlope - C = 75 Mbps - 100 Mbps = -25 Mbps = -3.125 B/us

all_parameters_used.CBS_service_curve: beta_Mi^h(t) = idleSlope * [ t - c_max/idleSlope ]^+_up (rate-latency). Here c_max=0 => beta(t)=9.375 * [t]^+
all_parameters_used.arrival_curve_per_flow: alpha_f(t) = l_f + (l_f/P_f) * t for t>0, 0 otherwise; with l_f=payload (Bytes), P_f (us)
all_parameters_used.aggregate_arrival_per_port: alpha_Mi^h(t) = min( sum_f alpha_f(t), sigma_link(t), sigma_CBS(t) ); with sigma_link(t)=C*t + l_max, sigma_CBS(t)=idleSlope*t + (c_max - c_min) + l_max. For computing bounds we conservatively used sum_f alpha_f(t) (burst b=sum l_f, rate rho=sum l_f/P_f) because sum_rho < idleSlope on all ports.

WCD_calculation.aggregate_arrival_curve_per_port: alpha_Mi^h(t) = min( sum_f alpha_f(t), C*t + l_max, idleSlope*t + (c_max - c_min) + l_max ). For bounding we used sum_f alpha_f(t) with b = sum l_f and rho = sum (l_f/P_f), since rho < idleSlope on all ports.
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_Mi^h(t) = idleSlope * [ t - c_max/idleSlope ]^+; with c_max=0 => beta(t) = 9.375 * [t]^+ (Bytes/us).
WCD_calculation.per_port_queueing_delay: D_Mi^h = hDev(alpha_Mi^h, beta_Mi^h) = T + b/(R - rho) with R=idleSlope, T=c_max/idleSlope=0. Units in microseconds.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_over_egress_ports_along_path(D_Mi^h) + hop_count * (prop_delay_per_hop + switching_delay_per_hop) = sum D + hop_count * (1us + 1us).

constants.IdleSlope_note: Single AVB class; no higher-priority AVB

equations.arrival_curve_source: alpha_f^h0(t) = b_f + rho_f * t, with b_f = l_f (bits), rho_f = l_f / P_f (bits/µs)
equations.arrival_curve_propagation: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-) deconvolved with delta_{D_f^(h-)}(t) (not applied in numeric aggregation; see missing_inputs)

credit_bounds.c_max: idleSlope * (sum_{j<i} c_min_j - l_>i^max) / (sum_{j<i} idleSlope_j - C); with single class A, this reduces to c_max = idleSlope * l_>i^max / C

equations.service_curve_per_port: beta_A^h(t) = idleSlope * [ t - c_max / idleSlope ]^+; here T_h = c_max/idleSlope
equations.per_port_delay: D_port = hDev(alpha_agg, beta) = T_h + b_total / (R - rho_total), with R = idleSlope and T_h = c_max/idleSlope
equations.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_{ports on path f} D_port + hop_count_f * (prop_delay + switching_delay)

notes: All flows are AVB Class A (PCP 6) sharing only queue 6 at each egress port.
Assumed no lower-priority (BE) interference: l_>i^max = 0 => c_max = 0 => T_h = 0 at all ports.
Computed D_port using aggregated affine arrival and CBS rate-latency service (R=75 b/µs, T=0).
Propagation and switching delays added per hop: 1 µs + 1 µs.

missing_inputs: Maximum lower-priority (best-effort) frame size per egress port l_{>i}^{h,max}: not provided. Assumed 0 bits (no BE), so c_max=0 and T=0 at all ports.

Whether end-stations implement CBS shaping is not specified; only switch egress ports modeled as servers.
Arrival curve propagation (alpha deconvolution with previous per-hop latency) across hops not applied in numeric aggregation (would increase effective bursts).
Application of Time Synchronization Error (1 µs) to WCD not specified; not added to WCD.
Link-level shaping AND with CBS shaping for aggregate arrival as per specification was not explicitly parameterized; used raw sum of affine arrivals per port.

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_per_flow: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f * t, with b_f = 8*payload_bits, rho_f = (8*payload_bytes) / P_f [bits/us]
WCD_calculation.aggregate_arrival_at_port: alpha_M(t) = sum_f alpha_f(t) over all class-A flows using that egress port
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_M(t) = R * [t - T]^+_{uparrow} with R = idleSlope = 75 bits/us and T = c_max/idleSlope. Here c_max=0 (no lower-priority traffic), so T=0

CBS_parameters.c_max: c_max = idleSlope * (sum_{higher} c_min - l_max_lower) / (sum_{higher} idleSlope - C) = 0 (no higher-class and no lower-priority traffic)

WCD_calculation.per_port_delay: D_port = hDev(alpha_M, beta_M) = T + B_total / (R - rho_total) (valid for affine arrival and rate-latency service with rho_total < R)
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_{ports h on path} D_port(h) + H*Propagation + (H-1)*Switching, with Propagation = 1 us/link and Switching = 1 us/switch, H = hop_count (links) from the provided path

CBS_common.beta_service_curve_form: beta(t) = IdleSlope * [t - c_max/IdleSlope]^+ with IdleSlope=75 b/us, c_max=0

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: For flow f with frame size l_f (bits) and period P_f (us): alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f * t for t>0, where b_f = l_f, rho_f = l_f / P_f.
WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_propagation: At each next hop h, per-flow arrival becomes alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-)(t + D_f^(h-)) which increases the burst by rho_f * D_f^(h-).
WCD_calculation.aggregate_arrival_curve_at_egress: alpha_M^h(t) = sum over traversing flows of min( alpha_f^incoming(t), sigma_link(t), sigma_CBS(t) ). With only Class A traffic, min does not tighten the affine arrivals (l_f <= l_max), so we sum the affine arrivals.
WCD_calculation.link_shaping_curve: sigma_link(t) = C * t + l_max, with C=100 b/us and l_max the maximum Class A frame size (bits) arriving to that egress.
WCD_calculation.CBS_shaping_curve: sigma_CBS(t) = IdleSlope * t + (c_max - c_min) + l_max. With c_max=0 and c_min = SendSlope * l_max / C = -0.25*l_max, this is 75 t + 1.25*l_max (bits).
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve: beta_M^h(t) = IdleSlope * [ t - c_max/IdleSlope ]^+ giving a rate-latency server with R=75 b/us and T=0 (since c_max=0).
WCD_calculation.per_hop_delay_bound: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_M^h, beta_M^h). For affine alpha and rate-latency beta with T=0, D_f^h = B_h / (R - rho_h), where B_h is the sum of bursts at that egress (including propagated bursts b_f + rho_f * D_prev per flow) and rho_h is the sum of rho_f of all flows traversing that egress.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_over_egress_hops(D_f^h) + (#links along path)*propagation_delay + (#switches along path)*switching_delay.

equations.arrival_curve_source: alpha_f^h0(t) = b_f + rho_f * t, b_f = l_f (Bytes), rho_f = l_f / P_f (Bytes/us)
equations.arrival_curve_propagation: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-) ⊘ delta_{D_f^(h-)}(t) => for affine curves: b_new = b_old + rho * D_prev, rho unchanged
equations.CBS_shaping_curve: sigma_Mi^{h-,h}(t) = idleSlope * t + (c_max - c_min) + l_max, with c_min = sendSlope * l_max / C and c_max = idleSlope*(sum_{j<i} c_min - l_>i^max)/(sum_{j<i} idleSlope - C)
equations.CBS_service_curve: beta_Mi^h(t) = idleSlope * [ t - c_max/idleSlope ]^+ (rate-latency). With l_>i^max=0 => c_max=0.
equations.per_port_delay: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_Mi^h, beta_Mi^h). For alpha(t)=B+R*t and beta(t)=S*t with S>R, D = B/(S - R).
equations.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_h D_f^h + hop_count * propagation_delay + (#switch_egress_ports) * switching_delay + time_sync_error

assumptions_applied: Only AVB Class A exists; j<i (higher AVB classes) empty; best-effort lower-priority max frame size l_>i^max not provided -> assumed 0; hence c_max=0 and CBS service latency term is 0.
Frame size l_f taken equal to payload Bytes provided (no L2 overhead included).
End-station (talker) ports are not modeled as CBS servers; first CBS server is the first switch egress on the path.
Time synchronization error applied once end-to-end.

missing_inputs: Max frame size of lower-priority traffic l_{>i}^{h,max} at each port (used for CBS c_max). Assumed 0 for computation.
Exact Ethernet frame size (payload vs. headers) for each flow. Assumed frame size = payload bytes.
Clarification on whether talker/source ports implement CBS shaping. Assumed only switch egress ports shape.
Clarification on whether time synchronization error is per hop or end-to-end. Assumed end-to-end single addition.

WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_equation: D_h = hDev(alpha_{Mi}^h, beta_{Mi}^h) with alpha_{Mi}^h(t)=b_h+rho_h*t and beta_{Mi}^h(t)=R_h*[t - T_h]^+; closed-form: D_h = T_h + b_h / (R_h - rho_h)
WCD_calculation.service_curve_parameters: R_h = idleSlope = 0.75*C = 9.375 B/us; T_h = c_max/idleSlope. With no lower-priority traffic: c_max=0 => T_h=0
WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_parameters: Per flow at source: b_f = l_f (Bytes), rho_f = l_f / P_f (Bytes/us). Aggregate at egress port: b_h = sum_f l_f, rho_h = sum_f (l_f/P_f)
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_over_egress_ports_on_path [ T_h + b_h/(R_h - rho_h) ] + hop_count*propagation_delay + (hop_count - 1)*switching_delay + time_sync_error

missing_inputs: Maximum lower-priority (BE) frame size per port (used in c_max); assumed 0 (no BE) for bounding
Exact Ethernet overheads (preamble, SFD, IFG, VLAN, MAC/PHY) not provided; payload taken as frame size
Exact initial CBS credit states; bounded via standard c_min/c_max formulas
Any other TSN mechanisms (e.g., TAS/GCL) not provided; only CBS considered as specified

formulas.c_max: idleSlope * (sum_{j<i} c_min - l_>i^{max}) / (sum_{j<i} idleSlope - C) => 0 (for Class A with no lower-priority traffic)

CBS_credit_bounds.service_curve_beta: beta_A^h(t) = idleSlope * [ t - c_max/idleSlope ]^+ = 9.375 B/us * t

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_source: alpha_f^h0(t) = b_f^h0 + rho_f^h0 * t, with b_f^h0 = l_f (Bytes), rho_f^h0 = l_f / P_f (B/us)
WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_propagation: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-) deconvolved with delta_{D_f^(h-)} => b_f^h = l_f + rho_f * sum(previous per-port CBS delays on the flow)
WCD_calculation.aggregate_arrival_curve_at_egress: alpha_A^h(t) = sum_f alpha_f^h(t) AND sigma_link AND sigma_CBS; here rho_sum << idleSlope so min reduces to sum of alphas
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve: beta_A^h(t) = idleSlope * [t - c_max/idleSlope]^+; with no lower-priority traffic c_max=0 => beta_A^h(t) = 9.375 B/us * t
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay: D_A^h = hDev(alpha_A^h, beta_A^h) = b_A^h / idleSlope (since beta has T=0 and rho_sum < idleSlope)
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_h D_A^h (over all switch egresses on path) + hop_count * PropDelay + (hop_count - 1) * SwitchingDelay + TimeSyncError

missing_inputs: Lower-priority/background traffic presence and max frame size l_>i^{h,max} per port (used by CBS credit upper bound c_max). Assumed none (l_>i^{h,max}=0).
Exact layer-2 overheads (preamble, SFD, IFG, VLAN tag) to convert payload to on-wire frame size. Assumed payload equals frame size.

WCD_calculation.per_port_delay: For each egress port h used by a flow: D_h = T + b_total / (R - rho_total), where R = IdleSlope (B/us), T = cmax/IdleSlope (us), b_total=sum of bursts (Bytes) of all AVB_A flows using port h, rho_total=sum of rates (Bytes/us) of those flows.
WCD_calculation.per_flow_WCD: WCD_f = sum over ports h on f's path of D_h + hop_count * (propagation_delay + switching_delay). With propagation_delay=1 us/hop, switching_delay=1 us/hop.
WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: alpha_f(t) = l_f + (l_f/P_f) * t (Bytes); used conservatively at every hop (no deconvolution tightening).

Aggregate arrival at each egress is dominated by the sum of flow bursts b_f = l_f, and slopes rho_total are well below idleSlope; thus hDev reduces to D_port = (sum b_f)/idleSlope for each port.
Deconvolution-induced burst growth across hops is neglected (worst-case per-port bound is used uniformly for the class as per NC TFA).
Propagation and switching delays are added per hop exactly as constants: 1 µs each.

constants.Switching_model: cut-through (not used directly in NC equations)

all_parameters_used.arrival_curves: Per-flow at source: alpha_f(t) = l_f + (l_f/P_f) * t for t>0; Propagation to next hop: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-)(t + D_f^(h-)) ⇒ burst update b_f^h = l_f + rho_f * sum_of_previous_Ds; Aggregate per-port alpha_A^h(t) = sum_f ( b_f^h + rho_f * t )
all_parameters_used.CBS_service_curve: Per-port beta_A^h(t) = IdleSlope * [ t - (c_max/IdleSlope) ]^+; with c_min = sendSlope * l_A_max / C; c_max = IdleSlope * (sum_{higher} c_min - l_lower_prio_max) / (sum_{higher} IdleSlope - C); Here, sum_{higher}=0 and l_lower_prio_max assumed 0 ⇒ c_max=0 ⇒ latency T=0
all_parameters_used.per_port_service_parameters: R = IdleSlope = 9.375 B/us; T = c_max/IdleSlope = 0 us
all_parameters_used.per_port_delay_formula: For affine alpha = b + rho*t and rate-latency beta = R[t-T]^+, D_A^h = T + b_total / (R - rho_total), requiring rho_total < R
all_parameters_used.WCD_equation: WCD_f = Σ over egress ports h on path(D_A^h) + hop_count * (Propagation_delay + Switching_delay)

missing_inputs: Maximum frame size for lower-priority (Best Effort) traffic per port (l_{>i}^{h,max}); assumed 0 ⇒ c_max=0 and T=0
Exact Ethernet framing/overhead (preamble, IFG, L2 headers); payload size was used as frame size l_f
Any non-AVB traffic presence and rates; none provided so AVB-A is the only shaped class

assumptions.frame_overheads: not added; l_f taken as payload size provided

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: For each flow f at its source h0: alpha_f^h0(t) = b_f + rho_f * t, with b_f = l_f (Bytes) and rho_f = l_f / P_f (Bytes/us).
WCD_calculation.arrival_propagation: At each subsequent server h, output arrival curve is deconvolution with pure delay: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-)(t + D_f^(h-)). For affine curves, the burst updates as b_f := max(b_f - rho_f * D_prev, 0), rho_f unchanged.
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve: Per port h for AVB A: beta_A^h(t) = idleSlope * [t - (c_max / idleSlope)]^+. With idleSlope = 0.75*C, sendSlope = -0.25*C, c_min = sendSlope * l_A_max / C, c_max = idleSlope * l_BE_max / C, latency T = c_max / idleSlope.
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: For affine alpha(t) = B + R*t and rate-latency beta(t) = R_cbs*[t - T]^+, the horizontal deviation is D_port = T + B / (R_cbs - R), provided R < R_cbs.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end: WCD_f = sum over egress ports h on f's route of D_port(h) + hop_count * (propagation_delay_per_hop + switching_delay_per_hop). Constants used: propagation=1 us/hop, switching=1 us/hop.

Exact Ethernet frame overheads (MAC header, VLAN tag, FCS, preamble, IFG); frame size taken as given payload. Including these would increase l_f and l_A_max, hence WCD.
Guidance on incorporating the provided 1 us time synchronization error into WCD (not included since the WCD formula specified only propagation and switching delays).

all_parameters_used.alpha_handling: For all ports, aggregate arrival curve alpha_Mi^h(t) = sum over incoming AVB_A flows of min(alpha_f, sigma_link, sigma_CBS). In this network, each flow's rho << 75 and << 100, so min() is dominated by alpha_f (no additional shaping limit engaged); thus alpha_Mi^h(t) is affine with b_total and rho_total used below.

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_per_flow: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f * t, with b_f = l_f (bits), rho_f = l_f / P_f (bits/us).
WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_propagation: At next hop: alpha_f_out(t) = alpha_f_in deconvolved with delta_{D_prev}(t) => burst b' = b + rho * D_prev (affine case).
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve: beta_ClassA(t) = idleSlope * [t - c_max/idleSlope]^+ = 75 * t (bits), since c_max = 0.
WCD_calculation.per_hop_delay: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_agg, beta) = b_total / (idleSlope - rho_total), with idleSlope = 75 bits/us and rho_total = sum of rhos of all AVB_A flows at that egress.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_over_egress_hops(D_f^h) + hop_count(f) * (prop_delay + switching_delay) = sum(D_f^h) + hop_count * (1 + 1) us.

WCD_calculation.per_port_delay: For an aggregate affine arrival alpha(t) = B + R_arr * t and CBS service beta(t) with rate R = idleSlope and latency T = c_max / idleSlope, the horizontal deviation is D_port = T + B / (R - R_arr), provided R_arr < R.

equations_used.arrival_curve_propagation: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-) deconvolved with delta_{D_f^(h-)}(t) => burst increases by rho_f * D_f^(h-)

CBS_credit_bounds.c_max: c_{A}^{h,max} = idleSlope * l_{>A,max} / C (assumed l_{>A,max}=0 => c_max=0)

equations_used.CBS_service_curve: beta_A^h(t) = idleSlope * [ t - c_max/idleSlope ]^+
equations_used.per_port_delay_bound: D^h = hDev(alpha_A^h, beta_A^h) = T + B_total / (idleSlope - rho_total), with T = c_max/idleSlope
equations_used.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_over_ports D_f^h + (prop_delay_per_link * hop_count) + (switching_delay_per_switch * num_switches) + time_sync_error_once

notes: Aggregate alpha at each egress port is the sum of shaped arrivals of all Class A flows that target that egress.

Link-shaping (C*t + l_A_max) and CBS-shaping (idleSlope*t + (c_max - c_min) + l_A_max) are applied via min(AND); with only Class A present and c_max=0, effective burst per incoming flow does not exceed l_A_max.

CBS_credit_bounds_assumption.rationale: No higher AVB classes present; l_lower(max) for BE/low-priority unknown => assumed 0.

all_parameters_used.arrival_curve: alpha_f(t) = b + rho*t, with b = l_f (bits), rho = l_f/P_f (bits/us)
all_parameters_used.alpha_propagation: At hop k>1: b_k = l_f + rho * sum_{j=1..k-1} D_j (deconvolution with previous server delay)
all_parameters_used.CBS_service_curve: beta(t) = R * [t - T]^+, R = idleSlope, T = c_max/idleSlope (here T=0)
all_parameters_used.per_hop_delay_equation: For affine alpha and rate-latency beta, D_k = T + b_k/(R - rho), provided R > rho.

equations.arrival_curve: alpha_f^h0(t) = b_f + rho_f * t, with b_f = l_f(bits), rho_f = l_f/P_f (bits/us)
equations.arrival_propagation: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-) deconvolved with delta_{D_f^(h-)} => b_h = l_f + rho_f * sum D_prev
equations.per_hop_delay: D_f^h = hDev(alpha, beta) = T + b_h / (R - rho_f) with R=idleSlope, T=c_max/idleSlope

assumptions: No lower-priority/best-effort maximum frame is given; set l_>i^max = 0 so c_max = 0.
All flows are the only AVB_A traffic on their egress ports (no same-class aggregation on a single egress).
CBS shaping and link shaping curves dominate alpha for single-flow case; the min() does not further tighten alpha.
Switch count equals number of egress switch hops along the route (hop_count - 1).
Propagation delay added per link equals hop_count.

missing_inputs: Per-port maximum frame size of lower-priority (best-effort) traffic l_{>i}^{h,max} (affects c_max).
Exact L2 overhead/headers if payload != on-wire frame size.
Full bidirectional port mapping for some links (we used logical egress labels like sw_X->sw_Y where port IDs were not provided).
Explicit instruction on where to add Time Synchronization error (we added a single 1us margin end-to-end).

equations.arrival_curve_source: alpha_f^h0(t) = b_f + rho_f * t, with b_f = l_f [Bytes], rho_f = l_f / P_f [Bytes/us]
equations.arrival_curve_propagation: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-) deconvolved with delta_{D_f^(h-)} => b_f(new) = b_f(old) + rho_f * D_f^(h-); rho_f unchanged

CBS_credit_bounds.c_max: c_{Mi}^{h,max} = idleSlope_{Mi}^h * (sum_{j<i} c_{Mj}^{h,min} - l_{>i}^{h,max}) / (sum_{j<i} idleSlope_{Mj}^h - C)
CBS_credit_bounds.assumption: For AVB Class A (highest AVB), sum_{j<i}=0; assumed l_{>A}^{h,max}=0 => c_max=0

equations.CBS_service_curve: beta_{Mi}^h(t) = idleSlope_{Mi}^h * [ t - c_{Mi}^{h,max} / idleSlope_{Mi}^h ]^+; here beta_rate = idleSlope, beta_latency = c_max / idleSlope
equations.per_hop_delay_TFA: D_f^h = B_h / (beta_rate - R_h) + beta_latency, where B_h = sum of bursts of class-A flows at port h, R_h = sum of their rates
equations.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_h D_f^h + (#links along path)*prop_delay + (#switches along path)*switching_delay

assumptions: All frames use payload size as frame size (no L2 overhead added).
No lower-priority (BE) interference on any port: l_{>A}^{h,max} = 0 => c_max = 0.
Per-hop propagation delay applied per link; switching delay applied per switch node; time-sync error not added to WCD.

missing_inputs: Maximum lower-priority (best-effort) frame size per port l_{>A}^{h,max} needed for c_max (we assumed 0).
Actual Ethernet frame size including headers/IFG for each flow (we used payload as frame size).
Whether to include time synchronization error in WCD and how (per hop or end-to-end).
Exact rule for counting switching delay (per hop vs per switch); we used per switch.

equations.arrival_curve_source: alpha_f^h0(t) = b_f + rho_f * t, with b_f = l_f (Bytes), rho_f = l_f / P_f (Bytes/us)
equations.arrival_curve_propagation: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-) deconvolved with delta_{D_f^(h-)}(t) -> effectively increases burst by rho_f * D_f^(h-)
equations.aggregate_arrival_at_port: alpha_Mi^h(t) = sum_f [ alpha_f^h(t) AND sigma_link(t) AND sigma_CBS(t) ], with sigma_link(t)=C*t + l_max, sigma_CBS(t)=idleSlope*t + (c_max - c_min) + l_max; in this setup, AND does not further reduce bursts (l_f <= l_max)
equations.CBS_credit_bounds: c_min = sendSlope * l_max / C = -0.25 * l_max; c_max = 0 (no higher-priority traffic, l_{>i}^{max}=0)
equations.CBS_service_curve: beta_Mi^h(t) = idleSlope * [ t - c_max / idleSlope ]^+ = idleSlope * t (rate-latency with zero latency)
equations.per_hop_delay: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_Mi^h, beta_Mi^h) = B_h / (idleSlope - R_h) where B_h = sum_f (b_f_effective at h), R_h = sum_f rho_f
equations.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_over_ports_on_path D_f^h + hop_count * PropDelay + (hop_count - 1) * SwitchDelay

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_source: alpha_f^h0(t) = b_f^h0 + rho_f^h0 * t, for t>0; with b_f^h0 = l_f (bits), rho_f^h0 = l_f / P_f (bits/us)
WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_propagation: At port h, for flow f: B_f^h = B_f^(h-) + rho_f * D_f^(h-), where D_f^(h-) is the latency bound at previous server (pure delay deconvolution). Rho is unchanged.
WCD_calculation.aggregate_arrival_curve_per_port: alpha_{A}^h(t) = sum_f alpha_f^h(t) AND sigma_link AND sigma_CBS. Here, with only AVB A and no lower-priority shaping assumed, min() does not further tighten vs alpha; we use the sum of propagated affine curves.

CBS_parameters.c_max_A: idleSlope * (sum_{j<i} c_min_j - l_>i^max) / (sum_{j<i} idleSlope_j - C); with only class A and l_>i^max=0 => c_max=0
CBS_parameters.CBS_service_curve: beta_A^h(t) = idleSlope * [t - c_max/idleSlope]^+ = R [t - T]^+ with R=75 bits/us and T=0

WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: D_A^h = hDev(alpha_A^h, beta_A^h) = T + B_total / (R - rho_total), with B_total = sum_f B_f^h and rho_total = sum_f rho_f at that port
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum over ports h on path of D_A^h + hop_count * prop_delay + num_switches * switching_delay + time_sync_error

missing_inputs: Maximum frame size of lower-priority (including best-effort) traffic per port l_>i^max; assumed 0 (no lower-priority interference) which yields c_max=0
Non-payload L2 overhead (headers, preamble, IFG); payload bytes were used as frame sizes
Whether talker endpoints perform CBS/FQTSS shaping; only switch egress CBS considered
Any background best-effort or other AVB classes’ load; assumed absent
Exact rule for applying time synchronization error (assumed added once end-to-end)
Queueing at ingress not modeled (egress-only queuing per CBS assumed)

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_each_flow: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f * t with b_f = l_f (Bytes), rho_f = l_f / P_f (Bytes/us) at source.
WCD_calculation.arrival_propagation: At each next hop: b_f := b_f + rho_f * D_prev_hop (alpha_out = alpha_in deconvolved with delta_{D}). rho_f unchanged.
WCD_calculation.aggregate_arrival_per_port: alpha_M^h(t) = B_h + r_h * t with B_h = sum of bursts of all Class A flows at the egress port h, r_h = sum of their rho.
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_M^h(t) = R * [t - T]^+, where R = idleSlope = 0.75*C = 9.375 Bytes/us, T = c_max/R, c_max = idleSlope * l_BE_max / C = 0.75 * l_BE_max. Using l_BE_max = 1500 Bytes, T = 120 us.
WCD_calculation.per_hop_delay_bound: D_h = hDev(alpha_M^h, beta_M^h) = T + B_h / (R - r_h), provided r_h < R.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum over all egress ports h on f's path of D_h + hop_count * 1us (propagation) + (hop_count - 1) * 1us (switching).

missing_inputs: Max lower-priority (BE) frame size l_{>i}^{h,max} per port not provided; assumed a network-wide BE MTU of 1500 Bytes to compute CBS c_max and T.
Frame size used is the given payload size; any L2/VLAN header/preamble/IFG overheads were not specified and hence not included.
Treatment of the 1us time synchronization error was not specified in WCD summation; it was not added to path WCD.
Interpretation of propagation and switching delays: assumed 1us per link and 1us per switch respectively.
Assumed CBS applies at all switch egress ports including egress to end nodes; no guard bands or additional TSN mechanisms were modeled.

WCD_calculation.per_port_arrival_curve: For each egress port h, aggregate the AVB class-A flows f traversing that port: alpha_h(t) = sum_f (b_f + r_f * t), with b_f = 8 * payload_f_bits, r_f = (8 * payload_f_bits) / P_f, with rates expressed in b/us.
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve: For class A with only one AVB class present, c_max = idleSlope * l_{>A}^{max} / C = 0 (assumed no lower-priority traffic), so beta_h(t) = idleSlope * [t - c_max/idleSlope]^+ = idleSlope * t, where idleSlope = 0.75 * C = 75 b/us.
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: For affine alpha_h(t) = B_h + R_h t and rate-latency beta_h(t) = R_s [t - T]^+ with R_s = 75 b/us and T = 0, the horizontal deviation gives D_h = T + B_h / (R_s - R_h) = B_h / (75 - R_h).
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum over egress ports h on f's path of D_h + hop_count * (propagation_delay_per_hop + switching_delay_per_hop). Using propagation = 1 us/hop and switching = 1 us/hop.

missing_inputs: Maximum lower-priority (best-effort) frame size l_{>A}^{h,max} at each port (used for c_max). Assumed zero because no BE traffic specified.
Layer-2 overheads (headers, preamble, IFG) to convert payload to on-wire frame size. Assumed payload == frame size.
Whether to include time synchronization error (1 us) in WCD. Not included because end-to-end WCD formula in prompt only adds propagation and switching delays.
Exact policy for counting switching vs. link delays at endpoints. Adopted simple per-hop 2 us (1 us propagation + 1 us switching) as instructed.

CBS.Service_curve_beta: beta(t) = R * [ t - c_max/R ]^+ with R=IdleSlope

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: For flow f at source h0: alpha_f^h0(t) = b_f + rho_f * t, with b_f = l_f (bits), rho_f = l_f / P_f (bits/us).
WCD_calculation.aggregate_arrival_curve_at_port: alpha_M^h(t) = sum_over_flows_in_class_on_port (alpha_f^h(t)). With one AVB class used, AND with link/CBS shaping does not tighten further under given parameters.
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve: beta_M^h(t) = IdleSlope * [ t - c_max/IdleSlope ]^+, with IdleSlope = 0.75*C, c_max = IdleSlope * l_BE_max / C (single-class case). Here c_max = 9000 bits, IdleSlope=75 b/us, so latency T = 120 us.
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: D_port = hDev(alpha, beta) = T + b_agg / (R - rho_agg), where R=IdleSlope, b_agg=sum of bursts (bits), rho_agg=sum of rates (bits/us).
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_over_egress_ports_along_path(D_port) + hop_count * PropDelay + num_switches * SwitchingDelay.
WCD_calculation.units: R, rho in bits/us; b in bits; delays in microseconds.

Clarification whether payload size should include L2 headers/FCS for l_f (assumed l_f = payload).

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_propagation: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-) ⊘ delta_{D_f^(h-)}(t); in this computation, the per-port shaping min{..., sigma_link, sigma_CBS} bounds the burst at each hop by l_A_max, so burst growth from deconvolution is upper-bounded by l_A_max and already captured.
WCD_calculation.aggregate_arrival_per_port: alpha_M^h(t) = min( sum_f alpha_f(t), C*t + l_A_max, idleSlope*t + (c_max - c_min) + l_A_max )
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve: beta_M^h(t) = idleSlope * [ t - (c_max / idleSlope) ]^+; with idleSlope = 0.75*C and c_min = sendSlope*l_A_max/C, c_max = idleSlope*l_BE_max/C
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_TFA: D_port = T + b_eff / (R - rho_sum), where R = idleSlope, T = c_max / idleSlope, rho_sum = sum of flow rates on that egress, b_eff = min( sum of bursts on that egress, l_A_max )
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_over_egress_ports_on_path(D_port) + hop_count * (propagation_delay + switching_delay)

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_source: alpha_f^{h0}(t) = b_f + rho_f * t, where b_f = l_f (bits), rho_f = l_f / P_f (bps)
WCD_calculation.arrival_propagation_and_shaping: alpha_{M_i}^{h}(t) = sum_{h-} [ alpha_{M_i}^{h-,h}(t) AND (C t + l_{M_i}^{h-,h,max}) AND (idleSlope * t + (c_max - c_min) + l_{M_i}^{h-,h,max}) ]; for our numbers, the AND with link-shaping caps each incoming group's burst at l_{M_i}^{h-,h,max}, and slopes remain the sum of flow rates (all << idleSlope), so b_total is the sum over incoming ports of l_max_bits, rho_total is the sum of their rho_bps

equations_used.arrival_curve: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f * t, where b_f = l_f (bits), rho_f = l_f / P_f (bits/us)
equations_used.CBS_service_curve: beta_M(t) = idleSlope * [ t - c_max / idleSlope ]^+ (rate-latency form); here R = idleSlope, T = c_max/idleSlope
equations_used.per_port_delay: D_port = hDev(alpha_agg, beta) = T + b_agg / (R - rho_agg)

notes: All flows are AVB Class A on PCP 6; only queue 6 is used.
c_max computed with only one AVB class and no specified lower-priority max frame size (assumed 0), hence T = 0.
Aggregate arrival at each egress port is the sum of flows traversing that egress port (same class).

missing_inputs: Maximum lower-priority/best-effort frame size per port (l_>i^{h,max}) to compute c_max exactly; assumed 0.
L2 overhead (headers/FCS/VLAN/IFG) to derive true Ethernet frame size from payload; payload used as frame size.
Any other AVB classes or BE/background traffic; none provided.
Exact interpretation of switching delay application (per hop vs per switch); here counted as hop_count * 1us.

CBS_formulas_used.c_max: c_max = idleSlope * (sum_{j<i} c_min_j - l_lower_max) / (sum_{j<i} idleSlope_j - C); here no higher classes and assumed no lower-priority => l_lower_max = 0 => c_max = 0

all_parameters_used.arrival_curves: For each flow f at its source: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f * t with b_f = l_f (Bytes), rho_f = l_f / P_f (Bytes/us). Aggregation at a port uses b_agg = sum b_f and rho_agg = sum rho_f over flows using that egress.
all_parameters_used.per_hop_delay_equation: For affine alpha and rate-latency beta, D_port = T + b_agg / (R - rho_agg), with T = c_max/IdleSlope and R = IdleSlope.

equations.arrival_curve: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f * t with b_f = l_f, rho_f = l_f / P_f
equations.per_port_delay: D_port = c_max/IdleSlope + b_agg / (IdleSlope - rho_agg)
equations.end_to_end: WCD_f = sum(D_port along path) + hop_count * (propagation_delay + switching_delay)

missing_inputs: Lower-priority (Best-Effort or AVB Class B) max frame size per port (l_{>i}^{h,max}) needed to compute c_max exactly. Assumed no lower-priority traffic at all ports => l_{>i}^{h,max}=0 => c_max=0.
No explicit L2 framing overheads specified. Frame sizes were taken as given payload Bytes.

No iteration over burst growth via deconvolution (alpha_out = alpha_in ⊘ delta_D) across the whole network; source arrival curves were aggregated per egress without upstream burst increase. Results are therefore optimistic upper-bounds for CBS delay under the given assumptions.
Host NIC shaping behavior (if any) not specified; analysis treats only switch egress CBS.

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: For flow f with payload/frame size l_f (bits) and period P_f (us): alpha_f(t) = l_f + (l_f/P_f) * t, for t > 0; b_f = l_f, rho_f = l_f / P_f.
WCD_calculation.service_curve_cbs: For AVB Class A at any port h: beta_A^h(t) = idleSlope * [t - c_max/idleSlope]^+ with idleSlope = 75 b/us and c_max = 0 (since no higher-priority AVB classes and assumed no lower-priority max frame specified => l_{>i}^{max}=0).
WCD_calculation.credit_bounds: c_min = sendSlope * l_max / C = (-25/100) * l_max = -0.25*l_max; c_max = idleSlope * l_{>i}^{max} / C = 0.
WCD_calculation.per_hop_delay: NC TFA horizontal deviation between sum of arrival curves and CBS rate-latency: D_h = b_agg / (R - rho_agg) + T with R=75 b/us, T = c_max/idleSlope = 0, b_agg = sum of bursts of Class A flows at that egress port, rho_agg = sum of rates.
WCD_calculation.e2e_delay: WCD_f = sum over all egress ports h along the given path of D_h + hop_count * (prop_delay_per_hop + switching_delay_per_hop). Here prop_delay_per_hop = 1 us, switching_delay_per_hop = 1 us.

missing_inputs: Max frame size of lower-priority (best-effort) traffic l_{>i}^{max} per port is not provided; assumed 0 -> c_max = 0 and T = 0.
No non-Class-A traffic volumes provided; only Class A flows modeled in aggregates.
Layer-2 overheads (headers, IFG, preamble) unspecified; treated payload as frame size.
Exact port directions in topology treated as bidirectional links; used provided paths as authoritative.
NC deconvolution across hops and min with link/CBS shaping curves not iteratively applied; standard TFA with conservative sum of source bursts used.
Time synchronization error (1 us) not added to WCD as constants specify only propagation and switching delays per hop.

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_per_flow: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f * t for t > 0, with b_f = l_f (bits), rho_f = l_f / P_f (bits/us).
WCD_calculation.aggregate_arrival_per_port: alpha_A^h(t) = sum_f (b_f + rho_f * t) over all AVB_A flows exiting port h (we conservatively skip the AND with link/CBS shaping as it only reduces burst).
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_A^h(t) = idleSlope * [ t - c_max/idleSlope ]_+, with idleSlope = 0.75*C, c_max = 0 here because there are no lower-priority flows in the given inputs; thus beta reduces to a rate-latency with R = idleSlope and T = 0.
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay: D_port = hDev(alpha_A^h, beta_A^h) = T + b_total / (R - rho_total) where b_total, rho_total are the aggregate burst and rate at that port; R = idleSlope, T = c_max/idleSlope.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_over_egress_ports_on_path(D_port) + hop_count * (propagation_delay_per_hop + switching_delay_per_hop). Using prop=1 us, switch=1 us, so +2 us per hop.

WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_over_hops(D_h) + hop_count * PropDelayPerLink + num_switches * SwitchingDelayPerSwitch + TimeSyncError.

CBS.Assumption_on_l_lower_max: No lower-priority (BE/Class B) traffic provided => l_lower_max = 0 bits at all ports

Arrival_curves.alpha_f(t): b_f + rho_f * t for t>0 else 0
Arrival_curves.Deconvolution_between_hops: alpha_next = alpha_prev deconv delta_{D_prev} => burst_next = b + rho * D_prev

all_parameters_used.Egress_port_aggregation: At each egress port in this topology, only one Class A flow traverses; hence alpha_Mi^h = alpha_f of that flow

Equations.Per_port_delay: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_Mi^h, beta_Mi^h). For affine alpha and rate-latency beta with T = c_max/IdleSlope, D_1 = T + b/(R - rho)
Equations.Inter_hop_update: D_k = T + b/(R - rho) + (rho/(R - rho)) * D_{k-1}, with D_1 as above; q = rho/(R - rho)
Equations.Server_delay_sum: D_server_total = sum_{k=1..H} D_k = D1/(1-q) * [ H - q*(1 - q^H)/(1 - q) ]

equations.arrival_propagation: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-) deconvolved with delta_{D_f^(h-)} => b_h = b_(h-) + rho * D_(h-), rho unchanged

cbs_credit_bounds.c_max: c_max = idleSlope * (sum_{j<i} c_min(j) - l_>i^max) / (sum_{j<i} idleSlope(j) - C)

equations.cbs_service_curve: beta(t) = idleSlope * [ t - (c_max / idleSlope) ]^+  => rate-latency with R = idleSlope, T = c_max/idleSlope
equations.per_hop_delay: D_h = T + b_h / (R - rho), R = idleSlope, T = c_max/idleSlope, b_h is hop-local burst

equations_used.arrival_curve: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f * t for t>0; b_f = l_f (bytes), rho_f = l_f / P_f (bytes/us) = (8*l_f)/P_f (Mb/s)
equations_used.CBS_service_curve: beta_Mi^h(t) = idleSlope * [ t - c_max/idleSlope ]^+; with idleSlope=75 Mb/s; c_max computed below

credit_bounds.c_min: c_min = sendSlope * l_Mi^max / C; sendSlope = idleSlope - C = -25 Mb/s; so c_min = -0.25 * l_Mi^max (bytes)
credit_bounds.c_max: c_max = idleSlope * (sum_{j<i} c_min_j - l_>i^max) / (sum_{j<i} idleSlope_j - C); here no higher-priority AVB classes and no lower-priority traffic assumed => l_>i^max=0; sums=0 => c_max=0

equations_used.per_hop_delay: D_h = hDev(alpha_agg, beta) = T + b_agg_bits / (R - rho_agg) with R=idleSlope, T=c_max/idleSlope; b_agg_bits = 8 * (sum of bursts of class-A flows exiting port h); rho_agg = sum of rhos of those flows

assumptions_applied: Only AVB Class A traffic exists in the network; no lower-priority (BE) frames appear => l_>i^max = 0 at all ports => c_max = 0
Aggregate arrival at an egress port is the sum of source affine arrivals of traversing flows (conservative, i.e., no deconvolution-induced burst reduction applied)
Switching and time synchronization errors are charged once per switch traversed (not per link)

missing_inputs: Whether lower-priority/best-effort traffic exists and its maximum frame size l_>i^max at each port (assumed none => l_>i^max=0 for c_max computation).
Exact rule for adding time synchronization error into WCD (assumed 1 us per switch).
Precise arrival-curve propagation (deconvolution) across hops; here conservatively not reducing bursts.

assumptions: No lower-priority (best-effort) traffic: l_{>i}^{h,max} = 0 on all ports, hence c_max = 0
Frame size equals provided payload (no link-layer/header overheads specified)
Switching delay counted per traversed switch: (hop_count - 1) * 1 us; propagation counted per link: hop_count * 1 us

equations_used.arrival_curve_source: alpha_f^h0(t) = b_f^h0 + rho_f^h0*t with b_f^h0 = l_f (Bytes), rho_f^h0 = l_f / P_f (B/us)
equations_used.arrival_curve_port: alpha_{M}^h(t) = sum_f min( alpha_f(t), sigma_link(t), sigma_CBS(t) ); here alpha_f(t) never exceeds sigma_CBS or sigma_link for our rates, so alpha_{M}^h(t) = sum_f (l_f + (l_f/P_f)*t )
equations_used.CBS_shaping_curve: sigma_M(t) = IdleSlope*t + (c_max - c_min) + l_{M}^{max}, with c_min = SendSlope * l_{M}^{max} / C, c_max = IdleSlope * l_{>M}^{max} / C = 0
equations_used.CBS_service_curve: beta_M^h(t) = IdleSlope * [ t - c_max/IdleSlope ]^+ = IdleSlope * t
equations_used.per_hop_delay: D_M^h = hDev(alpha_M^h, beta_M^h) = B_port / (R - rho_port) + T, with R = IdleSlope, T = c_max/IdleSlope = 0

WCD_calculation.method: Network Calculus TFA with CBS service curves per-hop (rate-latency) and aggregate affine arrivals
WCD_calculation.propagation_and_switching_accounting: Per path: +1 us per link (hop_count), +1 us per traversed switch (hop_count - 1)

missing_inputs: Maximum frame size for lower-priority traffic l_{>i}^{h,max} per port (assumed 0, i.e., no BE traffic)
Layer-2 overheads (preamble, IFG, headers) not provided; used payload as frame size
Exact interpretation of 'switching delay per hop' (assumed 1 us per switch)

all_parameters_used.propagation_rule: alpha_out(t) = alpha_in(t) deconvolved with delta_{D_prev}(t) = alpha_in(t + D_prev); hence per-flow burst at next hop: b'_f = l_f + rho_f * D_prev.
all_parameters_used.service_curve: beta_Mi^h(t) = idleSlope * [t - c_max/idleSlope]^+ with idleSlope = 75% of link rate; here c_max computed with l_lower_prio_max=0 so T=c_max/idleSlope=0.
all_parameters_used.unit_conventions: Bytes and microseconds throughout; link rate C = 12.5 B/us; idleSlope R = 9.375 B/us.

WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_equation: For an aggregate Class-A arrival alpha(t) = b + rho*t at port h and CBS service beta(t) = R*[t - T]^+, the horizontal deviation gives D_h = T + b/R (with R = idleSlope, T = c_max/idleSlope).
WCD_calculation.arrival_propagation_equation: At the next hop, for each flow f: b'_f = l_f + rho_f * D_prev; rho'_f = rho_f.
WCD_calculation.aggregate_at_port_equation: b_agg^h = sum_f b'_f over all flows entering port h; rho_agg^h = sum_f rho_f.
WCD_calculation.WCD_end_to_end_equation: WCD_f = sum_{ports h on f's route} D_h + (num_links * PropDelay) + (num_switches * SwitchDelay).

equations_used.per_port_delay: D_M^h = hDev(alpha_agg^h, beta_M^h) = B_total / (idleSlope - R_total) with alpha_agg^h(t)=B_total + R_total*t

The aggregate rate R_total is the sum of flow rates rho traversing that egress.

WCD_calculation.arrival_propagation: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-) deconvolved with delta_{D_f^(h-)}; for affine curves this increases burst by rho_f * D_f^(h-)

CBS_credit_bounds.c_min: c_{Mi}^{h,min} = sendSlope * l_max / C (negative); with IdleSlope=75% of C, sendSlope = IdleSlope - C = -25% of C => c_min = -0.25*l_max
CBS_credit_bounds.c_max: c_{Mi}^{h,max} = 0 (no higher-priority AVB classes, no lower-priority traffic given)

WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve: beta_{Mi}^h(t) = idleSlope * [ t - c_max / idleSlope ]^+ = 9.375 * [t - 0]^+ (Bytes/us, us)
WCD_calculation.per-hop_delay_equation: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_agg^h, beta^h) = b_agg / (idleSlope - r_agg) when c_max=0 and r_agg < idleSlope
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD_equation: WCD_f = sum_over_hops D_f^h + (N_links * propagation_delay) + (N_switches * switching_delay); for 3-link paths: N_links=3 (3 us), N_switches=2 (2 us)

equations.arrival_curve: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f t, with b_f = l_f_bits, rho_f = l_f_bits / P_f_us

CBS_credit_bounds.cmax: c_max = idleSlope * (sum_{j<i} c_min_j - l_>i_max) / (sum_{j<i} idleSlope_j - C); for Class A only and no lower classes observed, l_>i_max assumed 0 => c_max = 0

equations.aggregate_arrival_at_port: alpha_{ClassA}^h(t) = sum_f min{ alpha_f^{in->h}(t), sigma_link^{in->h}(t), sigma_CBS^{in->h}(t) }; here min reduces to alpha_f (slopes << 75), so alpha_{ClassA}^h(t) = B_h + R_h t
equations.per_port_delay: D_port = (c_max/idleSlope) + B_h / (idleSlope - R_h), valid for R_h < idleSlope
equations.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_{egress ports on path} D_port + n_links * PropDelay + n_switches * SwitchDelay

equations_used: Alpha at source: alpha_f^h0(t) = l_f + (l_f / P_f) * t for t > 0
Arrival propagation to next hop: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-)(t + D_f^(h-))  (implemented as b_f := b_f + rho_f * D_prev)
Aggregate arrival per egress: alpha_agg(t) = sum_f (b_f + rho_f * t)
CBS service curve per egress: beta(t) = idleSlope * [t - (c_max / idleSlope)]^+, with idleSlope = 0.75 * C and c_max = 0 under stated assumptions
Per-hop delay (affine case): D_h = b_agg / (R - rho_agg) + T, where R = idleSlope, T = c_max / idleSlope
End-to-end WCD: WCD_f = sum_h D_h + (hop_count * propagation_delay) + (num_switches * switching_delay) + time_sync_error
notes: Link shaping and CBS shaping were AND-min'ed with each incoming alpha; since rho << idleSlope and l_f <= l_max_link, they do not tighten the affine alphas for these loads.
Number of switches per flow equals 2 (given 3-hop paths: node->sw->sw->node).

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: For flow f with frame size l_f and period P_f at its source: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f * t, with b_f = l_f [Bytes], rho_f = l_f / P_f [B/µs], t>0.
WCD_calculation.arrival_propagation: At intermediate node h: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-)(t) deconvolved with delta_{D_f^(h-)}(t) = alpha_f^(h-)(t + D_f^(h-)). Aggregate per-port arrival: alpha_M^h(t) = sum_{incoming h-, flows f in class} [ alpha_f^h(t) AND sigma_link^{h-,h}(t) AND sigma_CBS^{h-,h}(t) ].
WCD_calculation.link_shaping_curve: sigma_link^{h-,h}(t) = C * t + l_{M}^{h-,h,max}, with C = 12.5 B/µs.
WCD_calculation.CBS_shaping_curve: sigma_{M}^{h-,h}(t) = idleSlope * t + (c_max - c_min) + l_{M}^{h-,h,max}, with idleSlope = 9.375 B/µs, c_min = sendSlope * l_M_max / C, sendSlope = -3.125 B/µs; for Class A c_max = idleSlope * l_{>i}^{max} / C (taken 0 without BE).
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve: beta_M^h(t) = idleSlope * [ t - c_max/idleSlope ]^+_uparrow, i.e., rate-latency with R = idleSlope = 9.375 B/µs and T = c_max/idleSlope = 0 here.
WCD_calculation.per_hop_delay: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_M^h, beta_M^h). For affine alpha and rate-latency beta with rho < R: D_f^h = T + b_total / (R - rho_total).
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum over egress ports h on f's path of D_f^h + (hop_count)*(prop_delay + switching_delay) + time_sync_error. Here prop_delay=1 µs/hop, switching_delay=1 µs/hop, time_sync_error=1 µs (once per flow).

equations_used.arrival_curve_propagation: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-) deconvolved with delta_{D_f^(h-)}(t) => for affine, b_f at next hop becomes b_f' = l_f + rho_f * D_f^(h-)
equations_used.aggregate_arrival_curve_at_port: alpha_Mi^h(t) = sum_over_incoming min( alpha_f^{h-,h}(t), sigma_link(t), sigma_CBS(t) ); here min did not bind since rho_total << R, so sum of affine arrivals used
equations_used.CBS_shaping_curve: sigma_Mi(t) = idleSlope * t + (c_max - c_min) + l_Mi^{max}, with c_min = sendSlope * l_Mi^{max} / C, c_max = idleSlope * l_>i^{max} / C
equations_used.CBS_service_curve: beta_Mi^h(t) = idleSlope * [ t - c_max/idleSlope ]^+ ; used as rate-latency with R=idleSlope, T=c_max/idleSlope
equations_used.per_hop_delay_bound: D_f^h = T_h + B_h / (R_h - rho_h) for affine alpha and rate-latency beta (Total Flow Analysis), provided rho_h < R_h
equations_used.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_h D_f^h + N_links * propagation_delay + N_switches * switching_delay

general_steps: Map flows to egress ports along the given shortest paths, using queue 6 for PCP 6.
Compute IdleSlope (R) and SendSlope from Bandwidth C and IdleSlope fraction.
For each flow at its source: alpha_f(t) = l_f + (l_f/P_f)*t.
Per egress port: aggregate arrival from all incoming ports; since rho_total << R, shaping min operations do not tighten arrivals.
CBS service curve per port: beta(t) = R * [t - T]^+ with T = c_max/R; with no lower-priority traffic specified, c_max = 0 => T=0.

Per-hop delay: D^h = T + B/(R - rho), where B is the sum of bursts feeding that egress (including upstream delay inflation b' = l + rho*D_prev for flows that already crossed a server), and rho is the sum of rates at that egress.
Accumulate D^h over all egress ports along the flow, then add propagation_delay_per_link for each link in the path and switching_delay_per_switch for each switch in the path.

explicit_formulas.D_h: D_h = T + B_h / (R - rho_h), valid for rho_h < R

Layer-2 overheads (preamble, SFD, VLAN tag, IFG) not provided; used payload as frame size for l_f.
Guidance on including time synchronization error in WCD (given but not referenced by the provided WCD summation formula).
Presence/absence of other traffic classes (only AVB Class A flows were considered as specified).

CBS_bounds_used.assumption_for_c_max: No lower-priority traffic present on links, so l_>i_max = 0 and sum_{j<i}=0 => c_max=0

all_parameters_used.Arrival_curve: alpha_f(t) = b_f + rho_f * t with b_f = l_f (Bytes), rho_f = l_f / P_f (Bytes/us)
all_parameters_used.Aggregate_arrival_per_port: b_port = sum_f l_f, rho_port = sum_f (l_f / P_f) over flows using the egress port
all_parameters_used.CBS_service_curve: beta(t) = IdleSlope * [ t - c_max/IdleSlope ]^+, giving rate R=IdleSlope and latency T = c_max/IdleSlope
all_parameters_used.Per_port_delay_bound: D_port = T + b_port / (R - rho_port) provided rho_port < R
all_parameters_used.End_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum over all egress ports h on f's route of D_port(h) + (num_links * PropDelay) + (num_switches * SwitchDelay)

equations.c_max: c_max = idleSlope * ( sum_{j<i} c_min_j - l_>i_max ) / ( sum_{j<i} idleSlope_j - C )
